reports.title: CABOT CORPORATION REPORTS FOURTH QUARTER AND FISCAL YEAR 2026 RESULTS

guidance.heading: Outlook
section: Erica McLaughlin said, “I am honored and excited to take on the role of CEO for Cabot. Having been part of Cabot for many years, I have a deep appreciation for the strength of our businesses, the quality of our people and the differentiated positions we have built across our portfolio. I am energized by the opportunity to lead the company and build on this strong foundation as we enter our next phase of growth.”

Commenting on the outlook, McLaughlin continued, “Looking ahead to fiscal 2027, we expect Adjusted EPS to be in the range of $6.15 to $6.75. We anticipate continuing to increase volumes within our key growth markets, such as battery materials and electronics, as well as with strategic customer accounts.
